facts.value: The source defines three const unsigned char[256] arrays: __ctype_map holds character-classification bitmasks, and __lower_map and __upper_map hold byte-to-byte case-conversion results. Their aggregate source-level array size is 768 bytes; compiled section placement, contiguity, and ordering are not established by these declarations.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing assertion of a contiguous read-only compiled layout in source order. The declarations prove the element types and lengths, but no compiled layout artifact was available.

evidence.why: Defines the three fixed-size constant byte arrays and their distinct classification and conversion contents, without establishing compiled placement.
